cgx926Discovery.name: CGX-926
cgx926Discovery.stage: Sponsor-reported ongoing UK Phase 1/1b oral MC4R-corrector research in MC4R-deficient genetic obesity
cgx926Discovery.summary: Congruence reported first dosing on 19 March 2026 and its current patients page identifies an ongoing UK Phase 1/1b study in MC4R-deficient genetic obesity. The sponsor links that study to ISRCTN33084994, whose public record is titled Phase I trial: QSC303485 and defers its full drug, condition and outcome details. The linkage comes from the sponsor, not an independently named drug in the registry.
cgx926Discovery.ukAuthorisation: An ethics-approved UK research record and sponsor trial statement do not establish UK marketing authorisation. No MHRA clinical-trial authorisation is inferred from these sources.
cgx926Discovery.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or routine NHS treatment access is established.
cgx926Discovery.supply: UK research sites do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by SHIFT.
cgx926Discovery.limitations: No human efficacy, safety, weight-loss, muscle-preservation, strength or function outcome is established. Animal findings do not transfer to humans or general obesity. The registry defers the scientific title, drug, condition, eligibility and outcomes. Its dates are not typed as actual or estimated; target enrolment is not actual enrolment. The zero final-enrolment field is not interpreted as zero participants. No results/outputs are present. The March sponsor readout for H1 2027 remains planned. ClinicalTrials.gov exact-name absence did not prove absence of another registry.
